Ancient Sheikah technology allows it heightened functionality, Arrows fired from it travel in a perfectly straight line.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|Ancient Bow and Arrow|Tips|SSBU}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Bow |strength = 22 |durability = 120 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = Yes |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Ancient Bow}} Ancient Bows are obtained from the [[Ancient Oven]] in the [[Akkala Ancient Tech Lab]].{{Cite|Exchange for Ancient Bow?|Ancient Oven|BotW}} They can be bought for 1,000 [[Rupee]]s, 15 [[Ancient Spring]]s, 10 [[Ancient Gear]]s, and one [[Giant Ancient Core]]. They can only be purchased after [[Link]] has activated the [[Ancient Furnace]] with a [[Blue Flame]]. They are the result of [[Robbie]]'s research into [[Ancient Technology]]. This is common among pieces of [[Ancient Soldier Gear]], the equipment archetype that Ancient Bows belong to.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 175}} While Ancient Bows have high power and very high durability, their most notable feature is their immense range. Ancient Bows fire [[Arrow]]s in a straight line for quite some distance before the Arrows become affected by gravity, making them ideal for hitting far-off targets. However, they also have a slow draw speed, being only 70% of a typical Bow. Ancient Bows are one of only two Bows to have an altered Arrow gravity stat, the other being [[Silver Bow]]s, though the gravity reduction from Ancient Bows is significantly higher than the latter. Like other Ancient Technology, Ancient Bows will fold into a more compact shape on Link's back when he's not using them. Being made with Ancient Technology, they will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], nor will they attract [[Lightning]] during storms.
